details.name: Reporting File Information (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that receives the full path to an input file from the user, reads that file and reports the number of lines, the longest line, and the number of words on each line. Make sure that the program handles each specific exception that could occur.

details.name: Reporting File Information (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that receives the full path to an input file from the user, reads that file and reports the number of lines, the longest line, the number of words on each line, and the length of the longest word on each line. Make sure that the program handles each specific exception that could occur.
